title: Admissions journey
content: The admissions journey has five supportive steps: registration, application submission, an age-appropriate assessment, an interaction round, and admission confirmation. Families can begin with an online enquiry or campus visit.

title: Application documents
content: For an application, families should keep the student's birth certificate, recent passport photographs, previous school report cards where applicable, proof of address, and a parent or guardian photo ID ready. The admissions team confirms the final checklist for each grade.

title: Eligibility and grade placement
content: Grade placement is guided by the student's age, previous learning experience and an age-appropriate interaction. The admissions team provides personalised guidance after an enquiry; no eligibility decision is made automatically online.

title: Campus visits
content: Families are warmly invited to visit the campus. Select Visit Campus or make an admissions enquiry to arrange a convenient time with the team.
